sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:17

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:17:1
items.html: Until it becomes distant from the light by the measure of one Sefira: For as long as there is a coupling in the upper Sefira, behold, the illumination of the coupling reaches from there to the empty Sefira beneath it — whereupon this illumination reaches only the aspect of the posterior in the vessel, and nothing at all to the face, as above — and the face of the vessel is found downward. But after the light became distant from the upper Sefira as well, then even though there is still a coupling in the Sefira above the upper one, nevertheless the illumination of the coupling reaches only from an upper one to a lower one, that is, from the cause to its consequence, but not from above the cause of it. And therefore the illumination of the record returns, and it turns its face upward, as above. And this is what he is precise about: “until it becomes distant from the light by the measure of one Sefira.” As explained. And understand well.
